entities.summary: Qena University (QU) is a university in Egypt that provides teaching and research facilities. Initially a branch of Assiut University, QU was established in 1995. The university has a second campus in the coastal city of Hurghada, just south of where the Gulf of Suez meets the Red Sea. Its former campus in the city of Sohag became the separate Sohag University in 2006.
